{{Short description|1=Overview of and topical guide to combinatorics}}
{{See also|Index of combinatorics articles}}

'''[[Combinatorics]]''' is a branch of [[mathematics]] concerning the study of finite or [[Countable set|countable]] [[discrete mathematics|discrete]] [[Mathematical structure|structures]].
